# sirf.

> sirf. is a media and content house for personal branding, social media growth and branding. It works with five clients at a time, never a sixth, and does one thing at a time for each, with a senior team and full attention. "Sirf" is Hindi and Urdu for "only".

Website: https://www.sirf.website/
FAQ: https://www.sirf.website/faq
Contact: sirfconvos@gmail.com
Book a 30-minute call: https://cal.com/prasan-singh/sirfyou
Founder: Prasan Singh (https://linkedin.com/in/prasan-singh)

## Personal branding

sirf. builds personal brands for founders, CEOs and leaders: positioning, voice, and the content system that carries it across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube and short-form video. The founder's time commitment is about six hours a month, with one point of contact and no repeated briefs.

## Social media growth

sirf. runs content systems for social media growth: formats, series and a consistent publishing rhythm designed around the audience rather than trends, produced by an in-house media team (shoots, stills, edits).

## Branding

sirf. handles branding and brand identity: visual language, tone of voice and art direction, applied consistently across films, posts and pages.

## Everything sirf. does

- Personal branding for founders and leaders
- Content systems and social media growth (LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, short-form)
- Brand films: commercials, brand documentaries, launch films
- Campaigns and launches
- Branding: identity and art direction
- Media: an in-house team for shoots, stills and edits
- Strategy and distribution: positioning, channel planning, paid media, partnerships

## What makes sirf. different

- Five clients at a time, never a sixth: each client gets full attention instead of a slice of it.
- One thing in focus per client at a time, finished properly before the next.
- One point of contact from start to finish; no handoffs to people the client hasn't met.
- Senior people on every deliverable.
- About six hours of the client's time per month.

## Who it is for

Founders and personal brands, consumer and D2C brands, VCs and startups, and creators and media businesses who care about quality and want a partner rather than a vendor.

## How it works

1. Listen: one conversation, done properly; learn the business before touching the brand.
2. Commit: one brief, one dedicated team.
3. Craft: the frame, the grade, the sound mix, the caption; the last 10% is where excellence lives.
4. Deliver: finished, on time, nothing half-done. Then the next thing.

- What is sirf.? A media and content house for personal branding, social media growth and branding, working with five clients at a time.
- Does sirf. do personal branding for founders? Yes; it is one of its main services.
- Can sirf. help grow social media? Yes, through content systems built around the audience.
